gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Newport's own US store listing marks the Smart Battery Box '*Not compatible with lithium batteries' for the whole product, not just its meter, or that the LiTime box, which is rated for lithium, carries only a 16A breaker and fits a Group 31 lithium no taller than 8.66 in. Single-battery 24V Group 31 lithium packs (9.45 in tall) are excluded from that box and, by their own makers, from standard Group 31 boxes.
standout_why: I compared against the cited Newport 'Smart Battery Box FAQs', the cited Minn Kota 'Battery Power Center (No Longer Manufactured)' and 'Amp Draw / Circuit Breakers' articles, the cited Minn Kota wiring guide (it rendered empty), and Minn Kota 'Deep Cycle Battery Selection' (rank 3). Newport's FAQ says only that the meter 'feature is not compatible with Lithium batteries'. ChatGPT passed that on as 'the indicator is not accurate'. Minn Kota says its Power Center meter 'will always show fully charged' on lithium but that the box itself is usable with lithium. None of these pages gives the store-level exclusion for the whole Newport box. None gives the LiTime box's 16A breaker or 8.66 in internal height, and none says 24V Group 31 lithium packs don't fit standard Group 31 boxes. One caveat: Newport's FAQ limits the problem to the meter, so the store line may be a blanket caution. The page should quote it rather than explain why it is there.
decides: For a shopper with a LiFePO4 battery (one of ChatGPT's own follow-up options), ChatGPT's 'best overall' Newport Smart Battery Box is excluded by its maker. The pick should move to a box whose maker says it takes lithium, such as the LiTime Group 24/27/31 box ($84.99 at litime.com on 2026-11-10, below the $92.99 ChatGPT showed). The shopper then has to add the motor's own 50–60A breaker, because the LiTime box's breaker is 16A. For lead-acid/AGM on 12V, Newport stays the pick: its 60A breaker covers Newport's 62 lb motor on its own. A 24V single-battery Group 31 lithium (LiTime or Redodo 24V 100Ah, 9.45 in tall) should go in a tray, not in these boxes.

findings.label: Lithium compatibility (maker store listing)
findings.value: "*Not compatible with lithium batteries". Listed for a 'single 12V battery (not included)', paired with Newport's 12V 50Ah AGM
findings.note: Read from Newport's Shopify store data with storecheck.py search on newportvessels.com. Direct page fetches returned HTTP 429. The listing text quoted is Newport's own copy.

findings.label: US price, maker store
findings.note: storecheck.py search result. No compare-at price.

findings.label: Interior dimensions / max battery weight
findings.value: 13-3/8 in L × 7-3/8 in W × 10 in H interior; holds up to 77 lb
findings.note: The FAQ lists no BCI group sizes. A LiTime 12V 100Ah Group 31 (13 × 6.77 × 8.43 in) would fit these dimensions, but Newport's store listing excludes lithium.

findings.label: Breaker pairing by Newport motor
findings.value: Built-in 60A motor breaker and 10A accessory breaker. 62 lb motors don't need their included breaker. All other Newport motors, including the 86 lb, must keep their own breaker installed on or in the box. 24V 86 lb setups use two boxes wired in series.
findings.note: The FAQ says 'in parallel' but describes series wiring (12×2=24 V).

findings.label: Meter with lithium
findings.value: Newport's LED meters read incoming voltage and 'will not work' with lithium. Newport says to buy a separate lithium-compatible meter (about $15–$30) and that lithium below 13.8 V output can run its motors.
findings.source_title: Trolling Motor LED Meters With Lithium Batteries – Newport
findings.note: The article covers the meters on Newport's motors. It does not mention the Smart Battery Box.

findings.product: LiTime Group 24/27/31 Marine Battery Box with Voltmeter
findings.label: Battery fit and chemistry
findings.value: Internal 14 × 8.11 × 8.66 in (external 16.54 × 9.84 × 12.6 in). Fits Group 24, 27 or 31. Suitable for 'Lithium, Gel, Sealed, and Flooded' batteries up to 66 lb.
findings.source_title: LiTime Group 24/27/31 Marine Battery Box, Built-in Voltmeter
findings.note: Product page opened with WebFetch, plus the storecheck listing text.

findings.product: LiTime Group 24/27/31 Marine Battery Box with Voltmeter
findings.label: Circuit protection
findings.value: One 12V 16A breaker. Max continuous input/output 100A. M8 terminals. 6 AWG silicone cable. No motor-rated breaker.
findings.source_title: LiTime Group 24/27/31 Marine Battery Box, Built-in Voltmeter
findings.note: The page doesn't say which outputs the 16A breaker covers. A 16A breaker can't be the trolling-motor breaker, so the motor's own breaker (Minn Kota: MKR-27 60A where 60A is called for) has to be added.

findings.product: Minn Kota Trolling Motor Battery Power Center (discontinued)
findings.label: Fit and lithium
findings.value: Fits Group 24 and 27. 60A motor breaker, 10A accessory breaker. Usable with lithium, but the meter 'will always show fully charged'.

findings.note: Already in a cited rival. Included to complete the compatibility grid. It is not a Group 31 box.

findings.label: Minn Kota breaker for 60A motors
findings.value: Minn Kota recommends its MKR-27 60A breaker for motors that call for a 60A breaker. Minn Kota says QUEST motors draw no more than 60A, and a breaker larger than 60A must not be used on them.
findings.source_title: Deep Cycle Battery Selection and Recommendations – Minn Kota
findings.note: The QUEST limit is from https://minnkota-help.johnsonoutdoors.com/hc/en-us/articles/24943541720471-Trolling-Motor-Amp-Draw-Circuit-Breakers-Fuses-and-Extending-the-Battery-Leads, read the same day.
